cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two signatures on every trip consent form now. Reassuring. I taught you not to trust your first check; here's another pair of eyes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the only teacher here. We'll have to wait for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're finally waiting instead of checking your own work twice. No child boards until she's seen the forms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: June wrote them. She wants someone else to check her work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better, she's learnt the same lesson. Find a third checker, and ask who checks them; you can make that extra safeguard part of the trip plan.

reason: Use the actual distinctive Drive with a particular former-pupil habit. Keep vocabulary corrections informative, restrictions warmly delivered, and B practical concerns responsible for A next choice.
